title: One Open Account per Resident — Resident Trust Fund Accounts Register Rule
content:
**Rule.** Under the Resident Trust Fund Accounts a resident has at most 1 resident funds account that is not closed or declined. A resident readmitted after an earlier account was closed authorizes a new one. A new account is set up only when the resident has no other account that is awaiting authorization, active or in conveyance.

## What the register must show

The test is read from the center's own account register for that resident, before the new account is set up; what a caller remembers about an earlier stay does not replace the register. Every account of the same resident counts, whatever its tier.

| Resident's other accounts on the register | New account may be set up |
|---|---|
| none | yes |
| only accounts that are closed or declined | yes |
| one awaiting the resident's written authorization | no |
| one active | no |
| one in conveyance after a discharge or death | no |

## Basis Q&A

**A resident's account from a stay two years ago was closed after the funds were conveyed. The resident is readmitted. Is a new account possible?** Yes. A closed account does not count, and the readmitted resident authorizes a new one.

**The resident declined to deposit funds at admission and now wishes to open an account.** A declined account does not count against the limit of 1, so a new account may be set up.
